args: Perform daily read-only audit: Call GET /api/v1/owner/status and GET /api/v1/owner/today on https://ai-marketing-organization.onrender.com using curl.exe -m 30 with header x-owner-key from $env:OWNER_API_KEY (never echo or print the key). Summarize open actions and system readiness to stdout. Do not make code edits. Do not trigger deployments. Do not call paid LLM APIs.
display_name: Daily Owner Status & Open Actions Audit
description: Every day at 9:00 AM (Asia/Kolkata), performs a read-only audit of /api/v1/owner/status and /api/v1/owner/today using curl.exe -m 30 with zero code edits, zero deploys, and zero LLM tokens.
